name: WaitForFile
label: Wait For File
description: Suspends running the flow until a file is created or deleted.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full path of the file to wait for.

fields.name: Mode
fields.label: Wait for File to be
fields.description: Specifies whether to wait for file creation or deletion.

selectOptions.label: Created
selectOptions.description: Waits until the file is created.

selectOptions.label: Deleted
selectOptions.description: Waits until the file is deleted.

fields.name: FailWithTimeoutError
fields.label: Fail with Timeout Error
fields.description: Enable this to fail the activity if the file does not appear within the specified duration.

fields.name: Duration
fields.label: Duration (seconds)
fields.description: The maximum time to wait for the file before timing out.
